name: Eventixa – Modern Events Calendar, Event Tickets, Bookings & Event registration
author: Eventixa Team

sections.description:
Eventixa is a modern WordPress events calendar plugin that lets you create and manage events, build beautiful event calendars, sell event tickets, accept online bookings, manage attendees, organize venues and organizers, and streamline event registration from one intuitive dashboard.

  • Live Demo
  • Documentation

Whether you’re organizing conferences, concerts, workshops, webinars, exhibitions, meetups, sports events, festivals, training sessions, community events, or business events, Eventixa provides everything needed for event management, event booking, attendee registration, ticket management, venue management, and online event registration from one modern interface.

Built for performance, flexibility, and ease of use, Eventixa includes multiple event calendar layouts, advanced event management tools, event booking workflows, attendee registration, ticket management, recurring events, waitlists, payment gateway integrations, booking reports, email notifications, QR ticket check-in, and everything required to run professional events on WordPress.

Plugin Website | Live Demo | Documentation | Upgrade to Pro

Features

📅 Event Management Calendar

Create and manage unlimited events using a modern event calendar designed for event management, event booking, attendee management, venue management, and professional event registration.

Features include:

  • List View — Display events in a clean list layout with event booking, event registration, and attendee information.
  • Calendar View — Showcase events in a monthly event calendar with recurring events and event schedules.
  • Grid View — Present events in responsive event cards with event tickets, booking buttons, and event details.
  • Map View — Display event venues on an interactive map for location-based event discovery and event booking.
  • Venues — Create and manage event venues with addresses, maps, contact details, and venue information.
  • Organizers — Manage event organizers with profiles, contact information, and organizer listings.
  • Categories — Organize events using event categories for better event management and event filtering.
  • Event Images — Upload featured images to create attractive event listings and professional event pages.
  • Custom Event Colors — Assign custom colors to events for improved event calendar organization and visibility.
  • Virtual Events — Create online events with virtual meeting links and remote attendee registration.
  • Additional Fields — Add custom event fields to collect extra event information and attendee details.
  • Event Search — Help visitors quickly search events by keyword, venue, organizer, or event category.
  • Event Filters — Filter events by category, venue, organizer, date, and event type for faster event discovery.
  • Responsive Layouts — Fully responsive event calendar layouts optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

🎟 Ticket Management

Create, sell, and manage event tickets with flexible ticket options, attendee registration, booking management, ticket availability controls, and online ticket sales.

Features include:

  • Unlimited Tickets — Create unlimited event tickets for free events, paid events, workshops, conferences, and recurring events.
  • Paid Tickets — Sell paid event tickets with secure online payments, booking management, and attendee registration.
  • Free RSVP — Offer free event registration and RSVP bookings with attendee management and confirmation emails.
  • Multiple Ticket Types — Create multiple event ticket types with different prices, quantities, benefits, and booking options.
  • Capacity Limits — Control event capacity by limiting available tickets and attendee registrations for every event.
  • Booking Limits — Restrict ticket bookings per attendee to manage event capacity and prevent overbooking.
  • Sale Schedule — Schedule ticket sales with custom start and end dates for every event and ticket type.
  • Ticket Availability — Manage ticket availability automatically based on booking limits, event capacity, and sale schedules.
  • Custom Attendee Fields — Collect attendee information using custom registration fields during the event booking process.
  • Ticket Downloads — Allow attendees to download event tickets, PDF tickets, invoices, and booking confirmations after registration.

💳 Booking & Payments

Accept event bookings directly on your WordPress website with secure payments, attendee registration, booking confirmation emails, and complete booking management.

Features include:

  • Multi-step Checkout — Streamline event booking with a fast, user-friendly multi-step checkout and attendee registration process.
  • Booking Management — Manage event bookings, booking status, attendees, ticket sales, and event registrations from one dashboard.
  • Booking Details — View complete booking information including attendees, tickets, payments, invoices, and booking history.
  • Stripe Payments — Accept secure online payments for event tickets and bookings using the Stripe payment gateway.
  • PayPal Payments — Allow attendees to purchase event tickets using secure PayPal payments for online event bookings.
  • Offline Payments — Accept offline payments for event bookings through bank transfer, cash, or custom payment methods.
  • Booking Confirmation — Automatically confirm successful event bookings and attendee registrations after payment or approval.
  • Secure Checkout — Provide a secure event booking checkout with protected payment processing and attendee information.
  • Guest Checkout — Allow visitors to complete event bookings and purchase event tickets without creating an account.
  • Booking Confirmation Emails — Automatically send booking confirmation emails, payment receipts, event tickets, and attendee information.

👥 Attendee Management

Manage attendees, attendee registrations, attendee information, booking status, tickets, and event participation with powerful attendee management tools.

Features include:

  • Custom Registration Forms — Create custom attendee registration forms to collect event booking information and attendee details.
  • Attendee Information — Store and manage attendee information, contact details, ticket information, and event registration records.
  • Booking Status — Track attendee booking status including pending, confirmed, cancelled, refunded, and completed event bookings.
  • Ticket Assignment — Assign event tickets to attendees and manage ticket ownership for every event registration.
  • Attendee Lists — View searchable attendee lists with booking details, ticket information, and event participation history.
  • Export Data — Export attendee lists, booking data, event registrations, ticket sales, and reports in CSV format.

🎤 Speakers, Sessions & Agenda

Build professional event programs with reusable speakers and performers, structured sessions, and frontend agendas.

Features include:

  • Speakers & Performers — Create reusable Event Profiles and assign people to events.
  • Sessions — Add event sessions with optional times, session types, locations, and assigned speakers or performers.
  • Event Agenda — Display event sessions in a structured agenda on the single event page.
  • Recurring Event Agendas — Eventixa Pro supports Same Agenda for all occurrences or Different Agenda per occurrence.
  • Agenda Layouts — Eventixa Pro provides additional agenda presentation layouts for professional event schedules.

🛠 Event Administration Tools

Manage events and registrations more efficiently from the WordPress administration area.

  • Duplicate Event — Duplicate an event while preserving supported Eventixa event configuration, speakers, sessions, and related data. Eventixa Pro also preserves recurring-event configuration and recurring session/agenda mappings.
  • Manual/Admin Booking — Eventixa Pro lets administrators create bookings directly from the WordPress administration area.

🔌 Integrations

Connect event registrations with supported email marketing platforms using Eventixa’s shared integrations architecture.

  • MailPoet — Connect Eventixa events to MailPoet lists and add configured purchasers or attendees based on event-level settings.
  • Mailchimp — Eventixa Pro connects events to Mailchimp audiences and supports event-level audience, recipient, and tag configuration.

📧 Email Notifications

Keep attendees, organizers, and administrators informed with automated event booking, ticket, and registration email notifications.

Features include:

  • Booking Confirmation — Automatically send booking confirmation emails after successful event booking and attendee registration.
  • Ticket Emails — Deliver event tickets, PDF tickets, booking details, and event information directly to attendees.
  • Admin Notifications — Notify administrators about new event bookings, attendee registrations, cancellations, and payment updates.
  • Branded Email Templates — Customize professional email templates with your logo, event details, booking information, and branding.
  • Invoice Emails — Automatically send invoice emails, payment receipts, and booking summaries after successful ticket purchases.
  • Reminder Emails — Send automatic event reminder emails before upcoming events to improve attendee participation and reduce no-shows.

🔁 Recurring Events

Create recurring events with flexible schedules for better event management and event calendar planning.

Supports:

  • Daily — Automatically repeat events every day with flexible event booking schedules.
  • Weekly — Schedule recurring weekly events for classes, meetings, and regular event management.
  • Monthly — Create monthly recurring events with automated event calendar management.
  • Yearly — Plan annual events, conferences, festivals, and recurring event bookings.
  • Exceptions — Skip selected dates without affecting your recurring event calendar.
  • Additional Dates — Add extra event dates alongside recurring event schedules.
  • Occurrence Management — Manage individual event occurrences, event bookings, and attendee registrations.

⏳ Waitlist

Increase event bookings by managing attendees when event tickets are sold out.

  • Automatic Waitlist — Automatically add attendees to a waitlist after ticket bookings reach capacity.
  • Seat Management — Manage available event seats, ticket availability, and booking limits.
  • Automatic Promotion — Promote waitlisted attendees when event tickets become available.
  • Email Notifications — Notify attendees about waitlist status, ticket availability, and event bookings.

✅ QR Tickets & Check-in

Speed up event entry with QR ticket management and attendee check-in.

Features include:

  • QR Tickets — Generate secure QR tickets for every event booking and attendee registration.
  • QR Scanner — Scan event tickets instantly for fast attendee check-in and ticket management.
  • Ticket Verification — Verify event tickets before entry to prevent duplicate ticket usage.
  • Manual Ticket Search — Search event bookings and attendee tickets when QR scanning isn’t available.
  • Instant Check-in — Complete attendee check-in quickly using QR tickets or booking information.
  • Attendance Tracking — Track attendee participation, ticket usage, and event attendance reports.

🧾 Invoices

Generate professional invoices and ticket documents for every event booking.

  • PDF Invoice — Automatically generate PDF invoices for completed event bookings and payments.
  • Ticket PDF — Create downloadable PDF event tickets for attendee registrations.
  • Download Invoice — Allow attendees to download invoices from their booking details page.
  • Booking Receipt — Send professional booking receipts with ticket information and payment details.

📊 Reports

Analyze event bookings, attendee registrations, ticket sales, payment reports, booking reports, and event performance from one dashboard.

Includes:

  • Booking Reports
  • Attendee Reports
  • Payment Reports
  • Export CSV
  • Export PDF
  • Dashboard Analytics

🚀 Eventixa Pro Features

Unlock even more advanced event management features with Eventixa Pro.

  • Stripe
  • Recurring Events
  • Waitlists
  • QR Ticket & Check-in
  • PDF Tickets
  • PDF Invoices
  • Email Reminders
  • Advanced Reports
  • Booking Exports
  • Premium Email Templates

  • List View
  • 2 Single Event Templates
  • Min / Max Ticket Quantity
  • Virtual Events
  • Priority Support
  • Manual/Admin Bookings
  • Recurring Sessions & Agenda Modes
  • Additional Agenda Layouts
  • Mailchimp Integration
  • Future Premium Integrations

sections.installation:
1. Upload the Eventixa plugin to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Open Eventixa → Setup Wizard.
  4. The setup wizard automatically creates the required pages and configures the plugin.
  5. Create your first event, configure event tickets, attendee registration, venues, and booking settings.
  6. Publish your event calendar and start accepting event bookings and online ticket sales.

Need help?
Read the complete setup guide: https://eventixawp.com/documentation/
sections.faq:
Is Eventixa a modern events calendar plugin?

Yes. Eventixa provides List, Grid, Calendar, and Map views with a modern, responsive design.

Can I create unlimited events?

Yes. Eventixa lets you create unlimited events, event calendars, event tickets, attendees, venues, organizers, bookings, and event registrations.

Can I sell event tickets online?

Yes. Eventixa lets you create free RSVP registrations, paid event tickets, multiple ticket types, attendee registration, booking management, and secure online ticket sales.

Does Eventixa support recurring events?

Yes. Eventixa Pro supports daily, weekly, monthly, yearly recurring events, recurring event calendars, exceptions, occurrence management, and attendee registrations.

Can attendees receive PDF tickets?

Yes. Eventixa Pro automatically generates downloadable PDF tickets.

Does Eventixa include QR code check-in?

Yes. Eventixa Pro includes QR ticket generation, QR scanning, and attendee check-in.

Which payment gateways are supported?

Eventixa supports PayPal, Offline Payments, and additional gateways such as Stripe in the Pro version.

Is Eventixa suitable for conferences, workshops, concerts, and meetups?

Absolutely. Eventixa works for conferences, seminars, workshops, webinars, exhibitions, festivals, concerts, sports events, classes, and business events.

Can I migrate from The Events Calendar, Modern Events Calendar (MEC), EventPrime, or Eventin?

Eventixa is designed as a modern alternative for users of The Events Calendar, Modern Events Calendar (MEC), EventPrime, Eventin, and similar WordPress event plugins. Migration options depend on the source plugin and available tools.

Can I customize attendee registration fields?

Yes. You can create custom attendee forms with drag-and-drop fields for collecting the information you need.

Does Eventixa work with Elementor?

Yes. Eventixa works with Elementor and most modern WordPress themes.

Is Eventixa mobile responsive?

Yes. All event layouts are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I create free and paid events?

Yes. You can create both free RSVP events and paid ticketed events.

Where can I get help?

Visit our documentation at https://eventixawp.com/documentation/ or contact us through https://eventixawp.com/.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Unified Eventixa administration under a single, cleaner menu with contextual access to ticket and attendee-fieldset management.
  • Improved Events administration with smarter ordering for ongoing, upcoming, recurring, and recently completed events.
  • Improved event-management navigation and submenu ordering for faster access to bookings, attendees, categories, venues, organizers, coupons, reports, settings, and other tools.
  • Refined admin interface spacing, controls, integration cards, speaker/session management, and attendee actions for a more consistent WordPress experience.
  • Refined Speakers & Sessions layouts, recurring agenda controls, Event Profile proportions, and mobile participant grids.
  • Improved single-event section spacing and typography for clearer frontend presentation.
  • Improved contextual ticket and attendee-fieldset workflows while preserving existing management screens and functionality.
  • Added Speakers & Sessions management with reusable Event Profiles and structured frontend agendas.
  • Added Duplicate Event support for Eventixa event data, speakers, and sessions, with Pro compatibility for recurrence and recurring agenda mappings.
  • Added MailPoet integration with global and per-event recipient/list controls.
  • Added shared integration settings architecture with Eventixa Pro Mailchimp audience and tag integration.
  • Added Pro manual/admin booking workflow for creating bookings from the WordPress administration area.
  • Added recurring session agenda modes with Same Agenda and Different Agenda options, plus additional Pro agenda layouts.
  • General UI polish, compatibility improvements, and release-readiness refinements.

1.0.2

  • Improved waitlist reservation, offer expiry, queue handoff, and recurring-event isolation.
  • Improved waitlist administration with Eventixa styling, event/ticket/occurrence filters, search, pagination, statistics, quick views, queue actions, and responsive layouts.
  • Improved booking and attendee email workflows, placeholders, sender configuration, waitlist notifications, and ticket resend behavior.
  • Added durable customer invoice download links for email notifications.
  • Improved Reports filtering, recurring-event timezone handling, attendance and capacity accuracy, and date-range semantics.
  • Improved CSV and PDF exports with reliable pagination, Unicode support, currency-aware formatting, structured-value handling, and safer export permissions.
  • Improved checkout, payment, guest booking, ticket inventory, coupon, and waitlist checkout integration.
  • Improved Setup Wizard, settings synchronization, demo import reliability, admin metabox ordering, and booking notes workflow.
  • Fixed compatibility, validation, concurrency, and stability issues across Eventixa.

1.0.1

  • Improved Setup Wizard experience and onboarding.
  • Added demo content importer with sample events, venues, organizers, and tickets.
  • Added deactivation feedback to help improve Eventixa.
  • Improved plugin administration interface and overall user experience.
  • Added plugin action links for quick access to Settings, Documentation, and Get Pro.
  • Added plugin meta links for Documentation, Support, and Reviews.
  • Added global admin notices and important plugin announcements.
  • Fixed various UI issues and improved stability.
  • Performance improvements and minor bug fixes.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Complete event management solution for WordPress.
  • Create and manage events with categories, venues, and organizers.
  • Advanced event calendar with Month, Week, Day, and List views.
  • Powerful event search and filtering.
  • Responsive frontend event listing and single event pages.
  • Ticket management with flexible pricing options.
  • Secure checkout and booking system.
  • Guest and logged-in user booking support.
  • Booking confirmation and booking details pages.
  • Customer My Account dashboard for managing bookings.
  • Organizer and venue archive pages.
  • Email notifications for bookings.
  • PDF ticket and invoice generation.
  • PayPal and Stripe payment gateway integration.
  • Event sharing and calendar export support.
  • Accessibility improvements and modern frontend UI components.
  • Theme compatibility with Astra, Blocksy, GeneratePress, Hello Elementor, Kadence, Neve, OceanWP, and WordPress default themes.
  • Optimized performance, security, and extensible developer architecture.
